title: House heating system
desc: What type of heating and fuel source should our house use? (You and 20 simulated residents)

options.name: Gas condensing boiler
options.desc: Efficient gas boiler with low running costs but high CO₂ emissions.

options.name: Oil boiler
options.desc: Conventional oil-fired boiler. Moderate cost, high emissions, requires on-site fuel storage.

options.name: Air-source heat pump
options.desc: Electric heat pump using outdoor air, powered by a green electricity tariff.

options.name: Ground-source heat pump
options.desc: Geothermal heat pump. High upfront investment but very efficient year-round.

options.name: District heating
options.desc: Connection to the municipal district heating network. Reliable and low-maintenance.

options.name: Wood pellet boiler
options.desc: Biomass boiler using locally sourced wood pellets. Renewable but needs storage space.

options.name: Heat pump + solar thermal
options.desc: Combined system with rooftop solar collectors. Highest upfront cost, lowest running cost.

options.name: Cooperative biomass CHP
options.desc: Resident-run combined heat and power plant using biomass. Requires collective commitment.

options.name: Heat pump + gas backup
options.desc: Hybrid system: electric heat pump for most of the year, gas boiler for peak cold spells.
